g.text: end-to-end as production applies GIM. IG integrates along the WEIGHT-SCALING path this codebase already uses (--ig_k): each decomposable matrix scaled by α=k/K,

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: a zero-weight baseline. Five seeds, each sharing pilot positions and k-means init across all nine sensors, so the tests are paired. Plain grad×act beats the production

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: sensor by +11.8 components (t=4.00, p=0.016); integrating makes it monotonically worse (EAP−IG5 = +12.4, p=0.004); GIM's τ-softmax fix alone already matches EAP.
